controls.name: Logical and Physical Access Controls
controls.description: Restrict logical and physical access to systems and data.
controls.action_template: Review access controls for exposed services and SSL configuration.

controls.name: Logical Access Controls
controls.description: Protect against unauthorized access to applications and data.
controls.action_template: Sanitize user inputs and implement WAF rules to block XSS/injection attacks.

controls.name: Security for Remote Computing
controls.description: Security controls must extend to remote access and mobile devices.
controls.action_template: Close unnecessary ports. Restrict admin and database ports to VPN/firewall.

controls.name: Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities on a timely basis.
controls.action_template: Apply patches for identified CVEs. Prioritize critical/high severity vulnerabilities.

controls.name: Change Management
controls.description: Manage changes to infrastructure, applications, and configurations.
controls.action_template: Audit DNS records and subdomain configurations for unauthorized shadow resources.

controls.name: Injection
controls.description: Prevent injection attacks including SQL, LDAP, OS command injection.
controls.action_template: Use parameterized queries. Sanitize and validate all user-supplied input before processing.

controls.name: Data Integrity
controls.description: Ensure the integrity of data in transit and at rest.
controls.action_template: Renew expired SSL certificates. Enforce TLS 1.2+. Enable HSTS and fix certificate chain issues.

controls.name: Logging and Monitoring
controls.description: Detect, log, and respond to security events and anomalies.
controls.action_template: Enable comprehensive security logging. Ensure scans cover all critical assets and subdomains.
